products._note_sheath: 10 Nov 2026, in place of an intro: switching to the bare blade DRAWS it -- the sheath (sheath.png, this turntable's own 1080x2048 frame, matching frame 0's sheath to 2.8 levels) slides straight down off the blade and dissolves through sheath-mask.png (the designer's FadeHide, inverted, its soft edge put just under the seated sheath, rows 1686-1790). Both directions start from frame 0; a turned or pinched parang is faded back to it first, and the parang cannot be dragged while the sheath moves.
products._note_sheath_path: Not a straight drop (user, 10 Nov 2026): the blade curves, so a straight slide showed it beside the sheath (up to ~5800 frame px of blade, measured). `path` is keyframes [travel, turn, sideways] in frame px: travel = how far the mouth has dropped, turn = degrees clockwise about `pivot` (the mouth's centre, 507.5,613), sideways = extra x. Fitted by tools/fit-sheath-path.py (contact sheet: tools/sheath-path-sheet.py): at each travel, the turn (capped at 6 degrees, at the user's 'not too much') and shift that leave the least blade showing beside the sheath, then smoothed. Shown blade summed over the draw: ~14000 px against ~66000 straight; none from 80 to 280 px of travel and from 840 on. The ~950 px at rest is the two photographs differing (the bare blade sits slightly off the sheathed one), gone by 80 px of travel. The last keyframe (1190) takes the sheath's top (613) past the mask's edge (1790).
products._note_sheath_fill: The path alone still let the blade's tip peek out beside the sheath near the end of the draw (user, 10 Nov 2026; up to ~1360 px measured), so the sheath is made OPAQUE from its mouth down, at the user's word: `fill` is a solid backing that moves with it, from frame row fromY (619, just under the mouth at 613) to the bottom, with a soft top edge of `soft` px. Its colour is the artist's backdrop (#EFEFEF, what the frames' backdrop was painted to) rather than pure white, so no lighter box shows round the sheath. Measured with tools/sheath-path-sheet.py ... 619 20: blade showing below the mouth falls to <= ~220 px at any travel, and on the contact sheet none is visible; the blade simply ends at the mouth.

sequence._note_fit: Fraction of the product viewport height for the WHOLE uncropped 2048px frame. The parang itself fills about 68% of the frame's height, so it lands near Norhaiza's keris (0.68 of a cropped frame).
